issues.message: R0801 finding is attributed to mc.py:1 but the duplicate code lives at limit/local.py:200-215 and limit/placement.py:215-229; mc.py:1 shows neither the problem nor the fix location.
issues.fix: Refile the finding to src/nova/limit/local.py with lineRange {start:200, end:215}, or src/nova/limit/placement.py with lineRange {start:215, end:229}, so the finding points at the actual duplicate block rather than an unrelated line in mc.py.

issues.message: R0913 finding ('too many arguments, 7/5') and the lizard params finding ('7 parameters, threshold 6') at line 152 both report excessive arity on enforce_num_instances_and_resources with the same fix (introduce a dataclass); the R0913 entry is a duplicate of the params finding.
issues.fix: Drop the R0913 finding and add a note to the params finding's detail that pylint also flags this at its threshold of 5, providing convergent tool evidence.
